handoffs.message: BFF handoff packet complete at support/sidecars/DEPLOY-002/DEPLOY-002-SIDECAR-BFF-HANDOFF.md. Key findings: (1) all 33 L1 surfaces + 4 composed views + 3 SSE streams implemented; (2) query gap is data wiring not routing — env vars PANTHEON_GOVERNANCE_DATA_DIR and PANTHEON_RUNTIME_DATA_DIR must be set in compose; (3) frontend handoff materials (auth, envelopes, RBAC, SSE, errors) ready in §5. No canonical truth modified.
